title: Grey curtains
text: Grey curtains. These are great.  Just fyi... you get 2 panels in each package.  They are a very soft grey... perfect for my room.  I am using a tension rod and the extra large grommeted top slides along nicely and quickly.  Just as I would expect. I did press them just a bit as they were of course folded for delivery.  They are a fairly heavy material, as you would hope for a "room darkened" curtain.  The material is a soft, microfiber like material.  Very smooth.  Look nice, not cheap.  The measurements given are accurate. I will update my review should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: NICETOWN 50% Blackout Curtain Valances, Pure White Grommet Window Curtain Toppers Room Decor Tiers for Nursery/Bedroom/Master Room, 2 Panels, 42W by 18L + 1.2 inches Header
features: READY MADE: Package includes 2 valance panels with 12 grommets (1.6-inch inner diameter), W42" x L18"+1.2" header each panel ( Curtain's whole length is 19.2" from top to bottom).

REAL WHITE: Curtains adopt triple weave technology. Unlike other curtains where the middle layer is black, the middle layer in this curtain is white yarn. So you don't have to worry that white has impurity.

WIDE COMPATIBILITY: Use the tier to cover the lower portion of windows or used alone on short windows, they can blend in easily with your kitchen, bathroom, laundry room, studio or whatever you used them.
FABRIC&PRIVACY: Both sides are the same color. These curtains are not blackout. They only can block out 50% sunlight while still providing privacy. These curtains can complement any decor.

EASY CARE: Curtain tier is made to last. Machine or hand washable in cold water, tumble dry or naturally dry. Quick iron or steam clean when it is necessary. Easy care curtain helps you get rid of heavy and boring housework.
